name: Shivam Rana
title: Nomad Shibhu Trails
description: Uttarakhand travel itineraries by Shivam Rana (@nomad.shibhu): Panch Kedar, Badrinath, Gangotri, Valley of Flowers, Auli and more. Every trip starts in Rishikesh.

about.heading: Hi, I’m Shivam.
paragraphs: I’m a pahadi from Uttarakhand who lives in Mumbai, and I head back to the hills every chance I get. My trips are slow ones: long drives up the river valleys, early starts on the trail, old mountain temples and time in pahadi villages.
So far I’ve completed all five Panch Kedar temples and travelled to Badrinath, Gangotri, Harshil, Kartik Swami, Auli and the Valley of Flowers.

I share these journeys as reels on Instagram, and this site is where the full plans live: how many days each trip takes, what the trail is like and when to go. If you’re planning one, follow me and send a DM.
